name: Citizenship by Naturalisation — Exceptional Merit (2021 Cabinet Decision)

selection_odds.basis: No open application exists. Nomination-only, granted solely by Rulers' Courts, Crown Princes' Courts, Offices of the Executive Councils, and the Cabinet, based on federal-entity nominations. There is genuinely no path for the general expatriate population regardless of years resident.

requirements.blocker_text: This requires owning property in the UAE, and — critically — being NOMINATED by a Ruler's Court, Crown Prince's Court, Executive Council office, or the Cabinet. No open application process exists.

This requires specialisation in a scientific discipline of high demand, acknowledged scientific contributions, at least 10 years' practical experience, membership of a reputable professional organisation, and NOMINATION by a qualifying authority.

This requires active research work (university/research centre/private sector), at least 10 years' experience, documented contribution to the field, a recommendation letter from a recognised UAE scientific institution, and NOMINATION.
This requires one or more patents approved by the UAE Ministry of Economy (or a reputable international body), a recommendation letter from the Ministry of Economy, and NOMINATION.
This requires being a pioneer in art and culture, at least one international award, a recommendation letter from relevant government entities, and NOMINATION.

evidence_required.document: Documented achievement evidence matching the applicable category (patents, publications, awards, professional membership)
Nomination by a qualifying federal/emirate authority — cannot be self-initiated

sources.title: Emirati nationality - The Official Platform of the UAE Government (updated 13 Feb 2026)

notes: THE MOST DISTINCTIVE CITIZENSHIP ROUTE IN THIS ENTIRE MULTI-COUNTRY DATASET, worth flagging with maximum clarity: selection_method is 'nomination_required' rather than 'assessed' precisely because there is NO APPLICATION FORM, NO PORTAL, and NO SELF-INITIATED PROCESS of any kind — nominations originate SOLELY from Rulers' Courts, Crown Princes' Courts, Offices of the Executive Councils, and the Cabinet, based on recommendations from federal entities. Meeting every listed criterion in a group does NOT create any entitlement or even a right to apply; this is fundamentally different from every other 'discretionary' naturalisation route in this dataset (even Japan's and Singapore's discretionary systems at least have a formal application process an individual can initiate). dual_citizenship_allowed is TRUE for this exceptional-merit group SPECIFICALLY — a genuinely significant departure from standard UAE nationality law, which requires renunciation for descent, marriage, and traditional 30-year naturalisation (see ae_citizenship_descent). Spouses and children of successful nominees are included in the same grant. Other conditions: oath of allegiance, commitment to UAE laws, mandatory notification to government on acquiring/losing another citizenship, and citizenship is REVOCABLE on breach — a real, ongoing condition not present on most other countries' naturalisation grants in this dataset, which are typically permanent and irrevocable once granted (barring fraud). Confirmed explicitly: there is NO path for the general expatriate population regardless of years resident — this route exists structurally outside and separate from every other UAE residency route in this dataset, none of which lead anywhere near citizenship.
